ff-a-season-practice-pl-3.front: What not to do in the last two weeks?
ff-a-season-practice-pl-3.back: Change load, scope or rings. Each change needs a new zero.

ff-a-season-practice-pl-7.front: Dummy rounds with empty primer pockets: dry fire safe?
ff-a-season-practice-pl-7.back: No. Good for loading practice, but they do not protect the firing pin (Tikka).

ff-a-season-practice-pl-8.front: How does a dry fire session end?
